full_text_zh:
[P1] 羊咩咩的衣服
撰文/蔡欣颖 插画/朱家钰

[P2] 羊咩咩的衣服
撰文/蔡欣颖 插画/朱家钰

浙江出版联合集团
浙江少年儿童出版社
2/11

[P3] 嘿！我是小绵羊咩莉，我和家人一起生活在广袤（mào）的草原上，我们每天最主要的工作就是吃草和长大。我们住的地方气候寒冷，所以，我们总是穿着蓬松的毛大衣。

绵羊全身上下除了脸和脚是短毛以外，其他地方都长着又卷又长的毛。母绵羊和小绵羊没有角，只有公绵羊有角。

不同品种的绵羊，毛的长度不同，从6～10厘米到10～20厘米都有。

你看，我的羊毛拉长有10厘米哦！

我们的衣服蓬松又保暖，是不是很羡慕啊？

照片提供／清境农场

[P4] 绵羊毛保暖又吸汗
我们穿的这件毛大衣非常保暖，
毛卷曲柔软，蓬蓬的毛让毛衣吸汗又
透气，穿起来很舒服。有了这身羊毛
衣，再冷的冬天我都不怕。

羊毛的好处
羊毛能吸收水分，
锁住热量，产生保
暖的功效。

下雪天，我
也不会冷！

羊毛摸起来柔软顺
滑，富有弹性，且
不易被压扁。

这不是羊
毛衣哦！

羊毛摩擦不会
产生静电，穿
起来很舒适。

我们的羊毛衣
好处很多哦！

[P5] 小绵羊要剃毛了
夏天到了，原本冷飕飕的天气也慢慢变热了。有一天，农场主人拿出剪刀，对我们说：“大家快来剪毛吧！”妈妈和阿姨们都乖乖地去剪毛了，但是我们小绵羊却不想脱下毛衣，大家都想逃走！
▲剃毛的工具除了用电剪外，还可以用剪刀。
▶出生6～8个月大的绵羊就可以剃毛了。第一次剃下的毛叫作小羊毛，之后一般每年剃一次。
▲工人会从绵羊的肚子开始剃毛。
▲剃羊毛的动作要快速熟练，绵羊才不会不舒服。
剃完毛，夏天会感觉比较凉快。
我的毛衣被脱掉了。
剃毛后
绵羊身上的毛经过一年的时间，已经长得又浓又密了。夏天剃下绵羊毛后，绵羊又会长出新的毛，冬天又有新的厚毛衣了。
摄影／吴杨钦
5/11

[P6] 1 把剪下来的羊毛分类，再送到工厂去，用水反复清洗，将灰尘、污垢洗掉。

绵羊毛大变身

主人为什么要剪我的毛呢？我的毛剪下来后，会被送到哪里去呢？让我来调查一下。原来，主人把我的毛衣送去清洗，做成了一捆一捆的彩色毛线。

他们竟然把我的毛衣变成了毛线，但是，为什么要做成毛线呢？

2 再用梳毛机器把打结的羊毛梳开。

3 用机器将许多束羊毛并成一条密实的羊毛条。

4 将经过加工和染色的羊毛线绕成一团，就成了常见的毛线球。

[P7] 绵羊毛做成新的羊毛衣
用我的毛做成的毛线，又被送进纺织工厂
变成了新的毛衣、帽子和手套，看起来真漂亮。
小朋友穿上我的羊毛衣，准备过冬了呢！我的
羊毛衣真的很棒，今年大家一定都和我一样，
感觉超暖和。
毛衣好温暖哦！
你身上穿的
可是我的旧
毛衣哦！
真的吗？那要谢谢你，你的毛衣
穿起来真暖和。
不客气，你看，我
的新毛衣又长出来了！明年又可以做
成新的毛衣送给其他小朋友了。
羊毛的用途很广，可以织
成细密的布料，做成衣服、
袜子、帽子、围巾，或是
地毯和羊毛鞋等。
7/11

[P8] 多知道一点
绵羊和山羊
绵羊和山羊都是羊，那它们到底有哪些地方不一样呢？
绵羊 绵羊身上的毛较长，有的卷曲，有的又长又直，都可以用来做成毛线。绵羊不长胡须。母羊不长角，公羊长角。绵羊个性胆小，喜欢成群生活。
我们母绵羊是不长角的哦！
山羊
我们的公羊和母羊都会长角。
山羊身上的毛有的长、有的短，长毛山羊的毛也可以用来做毛线。山羊的毛色有很多种。公羊和母羊都会长角，角可以保护自己，年纪大了也都会长胡须。山羊不一定成群生活。
咩莉不要学山羊这样爬哦，很危险！

[P9] 毛衣好温暖
冷冷的冬天 我穿上毛衣
软软的 绵绵的 好温暖
冷冷的冬天 我爱穿毛衣
一针一线 有妈妈的爱心
冷冷的冬天 我爱穿毛衣
每条毛线 是小羊的礼物
毛衣毛衣 温暖我身体
毛衣毛衣 真谢谢你
毛衣毛衣 让我好美丽
穿上毛衣 我好开心
给爸妈的悄悄话
冷冷的冬天，穿上暖暖的毛衣，就像妈妈给孩子满满的爱一样温暖。随着季节的转变，这次的快乐儿歌在编曲上，呈现出有别于以往的温馨曲风，强调毛衣为孩子带来的幸福感。副歌部分特别使用了悠扬的竖琴滑音作为句子之间的连接，也让孩子穿上毛衣后获得的满足感回荡在歌曲中。
full_text_en:
[P1] Yáng miē miē's Clothes
Written by Cài Xīnyǐng, Illustrated by Zhū Jiāyù

[P2] Sheep's Clothes
Written by Cai Xinying  Illustrated by Zhu Jiayu

Zhejiang Publishing United Group
Zhejiang Children's Publishing House
2/11

[P3] Hi! I'm little sheep Meili. I live with my family on the vast (mào) grasslands. Our main job every day is to eat grass and grow. The place we live is cold, so we always wear fluffy wool coats.

Sheep have short fur only on their faces and feet; the rest of their bodies are covered in curly, long wool. Ewes and lambs don't have horns, only rams do.

Different breeds of sheep have wool of varying lengths, from 6–10 cm to 10–20 cm.

Look, my wool can be stretched to 10 cm!

Our clothes are fluffy and warm—aren't you jealous?

Photo provided by / Qingjing Farm

[P4] Wool is warm and absorbs sweat
The wool coat we wear is very warm.
The curly, soft, fluffy wool makes the sweater absorb sweat and breathe well, making it very comfortable to wear. With this wool coat, I don't fear even the coldest winter.

Benefits of Wool
Wool can absorb moisture,
trap heat, and provide
warmth.

On snowy days, I
won't feel cold!

Wool feels soft and smooth,
is elastic, and
resists being flattened.

This is not a wool sweater!

Wool doesn't generate
static electricity when rubbed,
and is very comfortable to wear.

Our wool clothes
have many benefits!

[P5] Little Sheep Need to Be Sheared
Summer has arrived, and the originally chilly weather is gradually warming up. One day, the farm owner took out scissors and said to us, "Everyone, come and get sheared!" Mommy and the aunts all obediently went to get sheared, but we little sheep didn't want to take off our woolly coats—we all wanted to run away!
▲ Tools for shearing include electric clippers and scissors.
▶ Sheep that are 6 to 8 months old can be sheared. The wool from the first shearing is called lamb's wool, and afterward, they are usually sheared once a year.
▲ Workers start shearing from the sheep's belly.
▲ The shearing motion must be quick and skilled so the sheep won't feel uncomfortable.
After being sheared, it feels cooler in summer.
My woolly coat has been taken off.
After shearing
The wool on sheep grows thick and dense over the course of a year. After being sheared in summer, sheep will grow new wool again, and they'll have a new thick coat for winter.
Photography / Wu Yangqin
5/11

[P6] 1 Sort the sheared wool, then send it to the factory, wash it repeatedly with water to remove dust and dirt.

Wool Transformation

Why does the owner cut my wool? Where will my wool go after being cut? Let me investigate. It turns out the owner sends my wool coat for cleaning and turns it into bundles of colorful yarn.

They actually turned my wool coat into yarn, but why make it into yarn?

2 Then use a carding machine to comb out the tangled wool.

3 Use machines to combine many strands of wool into a dense wool sliver.

4 Wind the processed and dyed wool yarn into a ball, and it becomes the common yarn ball.

[P7] Wool from sheep made into new woolen clothes
The wool yarn made from my wool was sent to a textile factory
and turned into new sweaters, hats, and gloves. They look so beautiful.
Children put on my woolen clothes and get ready for winter! My
woolen clothes are really great. This year, everyone will feel as warm as I do.
My sweater is so warm!
The sweater you're wearing
is my old
sweater!
Really? Then thank you, your sweater
feels so warm.
You're welcome. Look, my
new wool has grown back! Next year, I can make
new sweaters for other children.
Wool has many uses. It can be knitted
into fine fabrics to make clothes,
socks, hats, scarves, or even
carpets and woolen shoes.
7/11

[P8] More to Know
Sheep and Goats
Sheep and goats are both sheep, but how are they different?
Sheep: The wool on sheep is long, some curly, some long and straight, all can be made into yarn. Sheep don't grow beards. Ewes don't have horns, rams do. Sheep are timid and like to live in groups.
We ewes don't grow horns!
Goats
Both our male and female goats grow horns.
The hair on goats varies in length, and long-haired goats' hair can also be used to make yarn. Goats have many different coat colors. Both males and females grow horns, which can protect themselves, and they grow beards as they age. Goats don't necessarily live in groups.
Meli, don't climb like goats, it's dangerous!

[P9] Warm Sweaters
In the cold winter, I put on my sweater.
Soft and cozy, so warm.
In the cold winter, I love to wear my sweater.
Each stitch holds my mom's love.
In the cold winter, I love to wear my sweater.
Each thread is a gift from little sheep.
Sweater, sweater, warm my body.
Sweater, sweater, thank you so much.
Sweater, sweater, make me so beautiful.
Wearing my sweater, I'm so happy.
A little note for parents
In the cold winter, wearing a warm sweater is like the full love a mom gives to her child. As the seasons change, this joyful children's song features a warm, gentle melody different from before, emphasizing the happiness a sweater brings to a child. The chorus especially uses flowing harp glissandos to connect phrases, allowing the child's sense of satisfaction after wearing a sweater to resonate throughout the song.
full_summary_zh:
[P1] 本页是绘本《羊咩咩的衣服》的封面，展示了一位女士正在织毛衣，周围有几只小羊，窗外飘着雪花，营造出温馨的冬日氛围。
[P2] 本页为绘本《羊咩咩的衣服》的标题页，显示了书名、作者和插画师信息，下方有一条红色针织围巾的插图，底部标注了出版社和页码。
[P3] 本页通过小绵羊咩莉的自我介绍，介绍了绵羊的生活环境、习性以及羊毛的特点，画面展示了草原上一群绵羊吃草的场景，并配有卡通小羊对话，说明羊毛的保暖性和长度差异。
[P4] 本页通过文字和插图介绍了羊毛的多种好处，包括保暖、吸汗、透气、柔软、有弹性、不易压扁且不产生静电，并以卡通小羊的对话形式强调了羊毛衣的舒适性，背景为雪地中的绵羊群。
[P5] 本页介绍了绵羊在夏天被剃毛的过程，包括剃毛的工具、时间、方法和原因，通过文字和插图展示了剃毛前后绵羊的状态，并说明剃毛后绵羊会更凉快，且会重新长出新毛。
[P6] 本页通过图文并茂的方式，介绍了羊毛从剪下到加工成毛线球的四个步骤，并以小羊的视角表达了对羊毛被加工成毛线的疑惑。
[P7] 本页展示了羊毛被加工成各种保暖衣物的过程，通过小羊与小朋友的对话，说明羊毛衣的温暖和实用性，并介绍了羊毛的多种用途，如制作衣服、袜子、帽子、围巾、地毯和羊毛鞋等。
[P8] 本页通过图文对比介绍了绵羊和山羊的区别，包括毛发、角、胡须、生活习性等方面，并通过卡通小羊的对话强调了安全警示。
[P9] 本页以儿歌形式描绘了冬天穿上毛衣的温暖感受，通过妈妈织毛衣和孩子穿毛衣的场景，表达了毛衣带来的温暖与亲情，同时强调毛线来自小羊的礼物，画面温馨充满童趣。
[P10] 本页展示了一幅绵羊在绿草如茵的山坡上吃草的实景照片，前景叠加了两只卡通绵羊形象，背景中可见围栏和游客，整体画面呈现自然与童趣结合的风格。
